decision.scope: The Kani verification lane's walker families under catherine-6g2: the walker arena round 2 (bounded temporaries per the 0005 revisit trigger) plus the dangling family's exclusion redesign, measured under the 8 GB / 300 s standard.
decision.rationale: The lane extends: the recorded walker-arena trigger was executed and the first walker-family verification landed at probe level. (1) The temporaries arena (ARROWS_CAP; Bounded sort_pushed_by/dedup_pushed; bounded coproduct witness; pullback families emit straight into the walk's report vector — the extend_desugared machinery of the attributed counterexample is gone; fiber's plain Vec::push gone). (2) The dangling exclusion redesigned: the per-cell membership scan over the violations table — a symbolic-length inner loop re-enumerated per cell, measured as the walker symex wall (a dangling-only probe hung past 150 s alone) — replaced by per-slot violation flags derived in one pass, flat reads per cell; identical partition and emission order. Measured: the dangling family verifies in 47.7 s (SUCCESSFUL) as an isolated probe over the equation shape. Remaining, measured: the compose-side resolution walk (engine_compose under the families' symbolic forks, Kani pointer-validity machinery charged per re-expansion) still exceeds the 300 s wall in symex; check_*/soundness_* stay undetermined with the narrowed disposition and a concrete-bound resolution walk as the revisit trigger. Contract suite (132 suites, 633 tests), clippy -D warnings, fmt, and ledger-check all green; the four proved build harnesses are untouched.
holes_found: no declared walker harness (check_*, soundness_*) is a completed proof at the standard yet; the claims remain recorded obligations
the compose-side wall (engine_compose under symbolic forks) is attributed but not cleared; concrete-bound resolution walk is the next lever
decision.fixture_only_comparison: The fixture corpus and contract suite pin the parsed surface byte-identically but never execute the engine's symbolic space; today's gain is diagnostic: the walker symex wall is relocated from 'heap machinery' generally to the violations-membership scan (fixed, probe-verified 47.7 s) and the compose resolution walk (attributed, recorded trigger). Cost: three 300 s timeout runs, two probe runs (150 s hang pre-fix, 47.7 s proof post-fix), one instrumented profile set.
